# Synthetic review-campaign fixtures

Every identity, rating, comment, resolution, and decision in this directory is fictional test data. No fixture represents an academic review, and no question becomes reviewed or approved by using it.

The CSV files intentionally bind synthetic blank coverage rows to the current canonical question IDs so command-level validation can detect stale evidence. They contain no real ratings or qualitative judgments. Fixture outputs must never be interpreted as academic evidence.

`reviewer-a`, `reviewer-b`, and `reviewer-c` are pseudonymous test IDs. They do not identify real people. Generated campaign output belongs under ignored `tmp/question-review/`.
